title: René Adler — Grokipedia
content: René Adler (born 15 January 1985) is a German former professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper, earning 12 caps for the Germany national team between 2008 and 2013.](#ref-1)](#ref-2) Adler began his youth career at VfB Leipzig before joining Bayer 04 Leverkusen in 2000, where he progressed through the ranks and made his senior debut in 2003, going on to play 138 Bundesliga matches for the club until 2012.](#ref-3) During his time at Leverkusen, he contributed to the team's run to the 2009 DFB-Pokal final as runner-up and participated in youth international tournaments with Germany, including the 2005 UEFA European Under-19 Championship.](#ref-4) He then transferred to Hamburger SV in 2012, appearing in 117 Bundesliga games over five seasons, before finishing his playing career with 1.
